@source:    mentalism_companion
@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Seeming Enhancement
@category:  Base
@class:     Enchanter
#
# Format: <level> | <spell_name> | <area_effect> | <duration> | <range> | <type>
# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.
#
 1 | Light Seeming | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | 100' | Fm
 2 | Sound Seeming | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | 100' | Fm
 3 | Detect Seeming | 1 target | - | 100' | Pm
 4 | Smell Seeming | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | 100' | Fm
 5 | Animal Seeming | 1 spell | varies | self | U
 6 | Taste Seeming | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | 100' | Fm
 7 | Unseeming | 1 spell | P | 100' | F
 8 | Feel Seeming | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | 100' | Fm
 9 | Analyze Seeming | 1 spell | - | 100' | F
10 | Dual Seeming | 1 spell | varies | self | U
12 | Presence Seeming | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | 100' | Fm
13 | Far Seeming I | 1 spell | varies | self | U
14 | Plant Seeming | 1 spell | varies | self | U
15 | Esoteric Seeming | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | 100' | Fm
16 | Supernatural Seeming | 1 spell | varies | self | U
18 | Far Seeming II | 1 spell | varies | self | U
20 | Multi Seeming | 1 spell | varies | self | U
25 | Far Seeming III | 1 spell | varies | self | U
30 | Multi Seeming True | 1 spell | varies | self | U
50 | Far Seeming True | 1 spell | varies | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
The caster can create a visual (static or dynamic) image which is perceived in
the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The caster can set up
to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Seeming spell (this
action requires no concentration by the caster). This action can be triggered
on a given action by the target. The caster can concentrate and exercise
dynamic control over what is perceived in the target’s mind (thought the
target must still be within range of the caster for this to work).
@@ 2
As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of sounds.
@@ 3
Caster can determine if the target is being affected by an Overlay or Seeming
spell.
@@ 4
As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of smells.
@@ 5
This spell will allow the next Overlay or Seeming spell from either this list
or Seeming Law to be able to affect animal targets (though the spell must be
cast within one minute of completing this spell).
@@ 6
As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of tastes.
@@ 7
The caster can attempt to stop an Overlay or Seeming from effecting a given
being (note that the Overlay or Seeming must already be “detected” with a
Detect Seeming spell). The Overlay or Seeming spell is allowed a RR (at the
level of its caster or the spell level if the former is unknown); if the RR is
successful, it continues to affect the being. If the RR is failed, the spell
will no longer effect this being, other targets will continue to be effected.
@@ 8
As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of tactile sensations.
@@ 9
The caster can analyze a detected Overlay or Seeming spell to determine the
nature of the spell in terms of the hallucination it is generating within the
mind of the affected being. The analyzed spell is allowed a RR (at the level
of its caster or the spell level if the former is unknown); if the RR is
successful, no information is gained.
@@ 10
This spell will allow the caster to create up to two simultaneous streams of
perceptual input when concentrating on the next Overlay or Seeming spell from
either this list or Seeming Law. When providing two streams, the activity for
concentrating on the enhanced spell is raised to 75%. Note that the Overlay or
Seeming spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell.
@@ 12
As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a mental pattern which can be
detected by and interact with appropriate spells or special senses.
@@ 13
This spell will allow the caster to extend the range over which he can
dynamically concentrate upon the next Overlay or Seeming spell. Such a spell
will have a range of 100' per level of the caster. Note that the next Overlay
or Seeming spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell.
@@ 14
As Animal Seeming, except it will enable the enhanced Overlay or Seeming spell
to effect sentient plants.
@@ 15
As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of sensations appropriate
to a given esoteric sense. Examples of unusual senses would include sonar,
magnetic senses, the life detection ability of undead etc.
@@ 16
As Animal Seeming, except it will enable the enhanced Overlay or Seeming spell
to affect Elementals, Constructs, Golems, Spirits, Undead, and other
supernatural beings with at least minimal intelligence.
@@ 18
As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is increased to 1,000
feet per level of the caster.
@@ 20
As Dual Seeming, except the caster can supply up to three simultaneous
distinct streams of perceptual input and the necessary level of concentration
(for three streams) is increased to 90% activity.
@@ 25
As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is increased to one mile
per level of the caster.
@@ 30
As Dual Seeming, except the caster can supply up to four simultaneous distinct
streams of perceptual input and the necessary level of concentration (for four
streams) is increased to 100% activity.
@@ 50
As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is ten miles per level of
the caster.
